news.title: England aim to win over Wembley and revive Wonderwall in Spain glamour fixture
news.lede: Emotions of a Nations League match cannot pulse to the same levels as the World Cup but Tuchel needs to reconnect. Thomas Tuchel has pictured the scene. It comes after the final whistle has blown on England’s Nations League opener against Spain on Saturday night, the first post-World Cup fixture for both teams, and it has Wembley swaying to the strains of Wonderwall. It is a moment of communion, a reconnection with the Oasis classic that was the soundtrack to England’s World Cup campaign, which delivered so much only to end in such disappointment.

news.title: Shock Brazil draw a sure sign Socceroos have learnt from World Cup mistakes
news.lede: The Socceroos were denied their first win over Brazil since 2001 after Rayan equalised for the Seleção with only seconds left on the clock. Socceroos coach Tony Popovic reflected on the result post-match stating that there were many positives to take from the result and performance. Nestory Irankunda celebrating his goal in the Socceroos’ friendly against Brazil. “I think it’s maybe a sign of progress if we are a bit disappointed and I think the dressing room’s a bit quiet,” Popovic said.

news.title: Kane keen to banish World Cup demons as England host Spain in Nations League
news.lede: Harry Kane says England are eager to test themselves against world champions Spain in Saturday's Nations League meeting at Wembley. Harry Kane commented on the challenge of facing Spain in the Nations League. La Roja, who defeated England to win the final of the 2024 European Championships, achieved where the Three Lions did not in beating Argentina to get their hands on the World Cup this year. Spain and England meet once more at Wembley Stadium on Saturday evening, and for the captain, it is an opportunity for the team to prove that they can continue to compete with the best for honours.

news.title: A college football team adopted Norway’s Viking Row — and its coach’s culture made it an instant fit
news.lede: Norway's Viking Row was one of the most viral fan traditions of the 2026 World Cup. Now, months later, the chant has officially made its way onto American college football fields. The University of Minnesota debuted its own version of the synchronized rowing chant at its season opener at Huntington Bank Stadium. In the stands, the student section sat shoulder-to-shoulder in rows, pulling imaginary oars in unison and mimicking the exaggerated motion Norwegian supporters made famous this past summer.

news.title: England vs Spain: Thomas Tuchel faces crucial test against world champions as Nations League campaign begins
news.lede: After World Cup heartbreak this summer they kick-off their Nations League campaign against Spain on Saturday at Wembley. The arrival of the world champions in the capital will be a painful reminder of what England were so close to achieving in North America - and re-exposes the scar, as boss Thomas Tuchel put it - of the mistakes made late on in that semi-final loss to Argentina. Tuchel has been eager to highlight the positives of England's campaign at the World Cup, insisting the experience and bonds built through the tournament leave the group well placed to kick on and achieve success in the Nations League and then at Euro 2028.

news.title: Fabián Ruiz on Spain's success: ‘The hardest thing in football is winning again’
news.lede: Fabián Ruiz sees Spain's last three years as an amazing feat for his country, but the Paris Saint-Germain midfielder wants more in the Nations League. Fabián Ruiz reflected on his success with Spain in 2026 in an interview with AS. The midfielder, who was nominated in the 2024 European Championships Team of the Tournament, has now won a third major honour in four summers after lifting the Nations League trophy in 2023 and winning the World Cup this year. That most recent accomplishment came on a day that was already immortalised for the 30-year-old, and his experience in the USA will live long in the memory.
